integrity: The proof independently reconstructs both radius optima from the published vertex and facet systems, proves uniqueness by antipodal slabs and spanning arguments, and then checks the polar correspondence in both directions. Finite enumeration through n=5 is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the canonical matrix realization in the Frobenius metric. It does not determine extremal ellipsoids, mean width, intrinsic volumes, or radii after non-orthogonal unimodular coordinate changes. A general polar-pair theorem for equinorm vertices and equinorm facet normals could subsume the calculation under different terminology.
title: Signed Birkhoff polytopes and their polars have identical exact Euclidean radii
